scope: Compare AtlasDesk 3.2 desktop Firefox 125 CSV export reports by their exact triggering filter/steps, observable downloaded-file symptom and stated product/version/browser context. All CSV export reports are in scope; shared export vocabulary alone does not establish the same observable issue.

reports.text:
Context: AtlasDesk 3.2, desktop Firefox 125, English UI.
Steps: set the status filter to Open, then select Export CSV.
Observed: two Open rows are visible; download completes but the CSV contains only column headers and no data rows.
No claim about the internal cause is made.

Context: AtlasDesk 3.2, desktop Firefox 125, English UI.
Steps: apply the Open-status filter and click Export CSV.
Observed: the completed CSV has its column header but omits both Open rows displayed in the filtered list.
The internal cause was not investigated.

Context: AtlasDesk 3.2, desktop Firefox 125, English UI.
Steps: leave the status filter unset and click Export CSV.
Observed: all data rows are present in the completed CSV, but accented names become replacement characters.
The internal cause was not investigated.
